defs: n	A place where one road crosses another; an intersection of two or more roads.
n	(figuratively, by analogy) A decision point; a turning point or opportunity to change a direction, a course, or a goal.
n	(figuratively, by extension) A centrally located position.
n	(nonstandard) A fork in the road.
N	"Tonight She Comes" is a 1985 song by American rock band the Cars from their Greatest Hits album.
N	"Me and a Gun" is a song by American singer-songwriter and musician Tori Amos.
N	"Don't Let Me Get Me" is a song by American singer Pink.
